extracted.intended_audience: general readers, comedy fans, researchers, and Wikipedia editors seeking a catalog of Netflix stand-up comedy specials
extracted.subtask_description: A catalog-style Wikipedia page compiling Netflix original stand-up comedy specials (and related series/collections), with metadata for each entry such as title, release date, runtime, and language; includes sections for series/collections and upcoming projects. Useful for finding and comparing Netflix stand-up releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion criterion — Netflix original stand-up comedy specials
rubrics_metrics.description: "This article is about Netflix original stand-up comedy specials." (Page note: for Netflix original series and related specials, see List of Netflix original programming; for Netflix original films, see Lists of Netflix original films; for Netflix exclusive distribution stand-up specials, see Lists of Netflix exclusive international distribution programming.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implies the list is limited to programs that are Netflix originals (not merely exclusive international distribution). Items that are Netflix-exclusive-but-not-original are excluded and referenced in other lists; upcoming items may be listed if announced by Netflix or reliable sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title
rubrics_metrics.description: Column listing the title of the special (often formatted as "Performer: Special Title", e.g., "Aziz Ansari: Buried Alive").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Titles sometimes include the performer's name, joint performers (e.g., "Jeff Foxworthy & Larry the Cable Guy: We've Been Thinking"), or ensemble/roast titles. The page uses the official/commonly used title as released by Netflix or cited sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Release date
rubrics_metrics.description: Column indicating when the special was released on Netflix (e.g., "November 1, 2013").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dates are presented as release (premiere) dates on Netflix; for upcoming projects this field may be "TBA" or show only an announcement date. Series/collections use "Premiere" and "Finale" fields instead for ranges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Runtime
rubrics_metrics.description: Column giving the duration of the special (formatted as hours and minutes, e.g., "1 h 19 min" or just minutes like "58 min").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For single specials the exact runtime is listed. For series/collections the page often gives runtime ranges (e.g., "27–33 min", "23–30 min"). Special entries may include unusually long runtimes (e.g., multi-hour roasts) or shortened outtakes/extended cuts noted in parentheses or subtitle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language
rubrics_metrics.description: Column indicating the language of the special (e.g., English, Spanish, Portuguese, Korean, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Language denotes the performance language(s). Some collections/series entries use "Various". Non-English-language specials are listed alongside English-language ones; translations/subtitles are not listed as separate entries on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Series/collections descriptors (Premiere, Finale, Seasons, Runtime, Language, Status)
rubrics_metrics.description: For series/collections the page provides a separate table with fields: Title, Premiere, Finale, Seasons, Runtime, Language, Status (e.g., "The Standups — July 4, 2017 — December 29, 2021 — 3 seasons, 18 episodes — 27–33 min — English — Ended").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These descriptors capture multi-episode or recurring releases rather than single stand-up specials: "Premiere" and "Finale" give the series run dates; "Seasons" gives counts (and sometimes episode counts); "Runtime" gives per-episode ranges; "Status" indicates whether the series is ended or ongoing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Upcoming / Awaiting release designation
rubrics_metrics.description: Section listing projects that have been announced as in development but do not have a specific release date (table columns: Title, Release date, Runtime, Language; entries often show "TBA").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to record announced Netflix original stand-up specials with no confirmed release date. References/notes cite trade press or Netflix pages when available. Items remain in this section until a release date is confirmed and the entry is moved to the main list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status labels for series and collections
rubrics_metrics.description: Status values used in the series/collections table such as "Ended" (or implicitly current/ongoing when no end is listed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates whether a series/collection is still active or has concluded; used alongside Premiere/Finale dates to contextualize the run. Individual specials generally lack a separate status field since they are single-release items.
